conviction_note: Q3 2026 numbers are new (no szacunkowe-wyniki pre-release this time, because Ferrovial reports 9M after Budimex), and the CEO said on 2026-09-11 that the new multi-year strategy will be published together with the Q3 results, so this is a guidance-type event. abs_move is set at 7.5, between the name's own +7.85% Q3 2025 reaction and the European 9% guidance base. The sign evidence is thin and roughly balanced: September sector output was weak (public), the stock trades above every sell-side target, and the strategy's direction is unknown. So p_up is 48 and the scaled number (-0.3) is close to the findings' sum (-0.4).

already_public.what: Report date: consolidated Q3 2026 report on 27 Oct 2026 (Raport bieżący 4/2026); no separate pre-release scheduled for Q3 (the Ferrovial-driven 'wybrane dane' pre-releases were only for FY2025 on 24 Feb and H1 on 28 Jul)

H1 2026: revenue 4.23 bn PLN, EBIT 309 m, net 249.7 m; Q2 net 163.4 m in line with the July estimate; backlog 17.9 bn at 30 June; ~620 m signed after June; ~3.3 bn of lowest/top-rated bids; net cash >1.2 bn after an 828 m dividend; management expects working capital to convert to cash in Q3 and Q4
2027 target of revenue +6-10% at a similar margin; strategy to be presented with the Q3 results at the end of October; acquisitions possible in 2027; data-centre investments; possible divestments
GUS: September construction output -9% y/y against a PAP consensus of +15.4%; August +6.7% (civil engineering led); July -2.4%

new_in_release.expect: New 5-year strategy (10-year horizon) published with the results: growth targets, diversification (data centres, foreign markets, services, renewables), M&A and possibly dividend policy. Direction unknown. The 2027 revenue +6-10% target is already public, so the new content is capex, M&A and payout.

Q3 revenue, EBIT and net are new, with no pre-release. Management signalled 'high production' and >10 bn FY revenue (H2 needs >=5.77 bn against 5.45 bn in H2 2025). Sector output was weak in July and September. Expect roughly in line to slightly soft. There is no sourced consensus.

Seasonal working-capital release guided for Q3/Q4, so operating cash flow should turn positive. The Turów settlement payment (consortium paid 135 m PLN by 22 Sep; Budimex share undisclosed) is a partial offset.
Backlog at 30 Sep, probably ~18 bn and stable to up: Bechtel, DK10, Port Polska and Katowice tram wins; Czajka bid rejected.

bar: unsourced. No PAP Biznes consensus for Q3 2026 was found as of 2026-10-26 (it is usually published on the day). The nearest company bar is the >10 bn PLN 2026 revenue ambition (https://inwestycje.pl/gielda/budimex-widzi-mozliwosc-przekroczenia-10-mld-zl-przychodow-w-2026-roku/) and the 'high production in the coming months' language in the H1 report. Every finding is capped small for that reason.
session_check: amc -- the issuer's own calendar (RB 4/2026, https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art43684991-budimex-sa-terminy-przekazywania-okresowych-raportow-finansowych-w-2026-roku) fixes 27 Oct 2026 but gives no hour. The two most recent comparable quarterly reports were filed after the Warsaw close: QSr 3/2025 at 27.10.2025 18:18 (https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art43245581-budimex-sa-qsr-3-2025-formularz-rozszerzonego-skonsolidowanego-raportu-kwartalnego), with the reaction on 28 Oct 2025 (+7.85%), and QSr 1/2026 at 06.05.2026 19:33 (https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44325781-budimex-sa-qsr-1-2026-formularz-rozszerzonego-skonsolidowanego-raportu-kwartalnego). Only the H1 report came before the session (Bankier 21.08.2026 07:16), and that period had been pre-released. So the expected window is the 27 Oct close to the 28 Oct close, NOT the sealed 26 Oct -> 27 Oct bmo window. The 27 Oct timestamp is inferred from prior cycles and is not yet observed.
positioning_check: Register not covered for this market: the KNF short register is unreadable (403) and gpw.pl/espi.pap.pl refuse, so nothing is known about short interest. This is not a zero. priced_lean_pct (-0.265) is the 20-day run-up (+5.29%) and so equals the free control. The only positioning-type evidence is sell-side: per Bankier, over 12 months there were 3 sell, 2 underweight and 2 buy ratings, with an average target of 627 PLN (range 562-700) against spot ~728, so the stock trades above every target (https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/BUDIMEX/rekomendacje, read 2026-10-26).

findings.finding: The CEO said the new development strategy will be presented together with the Q3 results at the end of October. Content flagged so far: diversification, M&A from 2027, data centres where Budimex 'finances its investments to a greater extent', possible divestments. The 2027 revenue +6-10% and stable margin target is already public, so what is new is capital allocation, and for a ~100%-payout dividend name that skews slightly negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior strategy release in the window history. The Q3 2025 report, in line on net profit, was followed by +7.85% the next session, so this name can move far on non-headline content.
findings.original_quote: "Pod koniec października, wraz z publikacją wyników za trzeci kwartał, planujemy przedstawić nową strategię." / "Chcielibyśmy wejść w nowe obszary działalności, w tym w obszary, gdzie finansujemy swoje inwestycje w większym zakresie." (At the end of October, together with the Q3 results, we plan to present the new strategy. / We would like to enter new areas, including areas where we finance our investments to a greater extent.)
findings.why_not_priced: The timing is public but the contents are not. If the market had priced a capex-heavy or payout-cutting strategy, the stock would not be sitting 16% above the average sell-side target and up 2.4% on the eve. If it had priced an ambitious upside plan, sell-side targets would already have moved toward the price, and they have not (Noble cut to 562 on 17 Sep).
findings.independence: An undated PAP headline says the board wants to extend the current dividend policy beyond 2026 (https://biznes.pap.pl/wiadomosci/firmy/budimex-builders-management-board-wants-extend-current-dividend-policy-beyond-2026, snippet only, bot-blocked), which cuts against the negative skew. That is why this finding is kept near zero.

findings.finding: Polish construction output was weak in Q3: September -9% y/y against a +15.4% PAP consensus (seasonally adjusted -7.2% y/y), July -2.4%, August +6.7% with civil engineering leading. Budimex's Q3 revenue therefore has little sector tailwind against management's 'high production' language.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 net profit missed the PAP consensus (163.4 vs 169 m) and the stock fell 3.58% on 29 Jul. Q1 2026 was in line and the stock fell 2.78% and then 2.68% (with a BDM downgrade).
findings.original_quote: "Produkcja budowlano-montażowa spadła o 9 proc. – podał GUS. ... Konsensus PAP zakładał ... wzrost budowlanki o 15,4 proc." (Construction-assembly output fell 9%, GUS said; the PAP consensus assumed construction growth of 15.4%.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It has been public since 20 Oct and the stock rose about 2% after it. What is left is a macro-to-company transmission: Pekao notes that this year's irregular settlement timing makes the monthly series noisy, and Budimex's backlog conversion is company-specific. It is kept small as a proxy.
findings.independence: The August release (https://xyz.pl/?p=251963) shows civil engineering, Budimex's segment, leading a +6.7% month, which partly offsets this. Nothing company-level points the same way.

findings.finding: Management guided that the seasonally built-up working capital will convert to cash in Q3 and Q4, after net cash fell to >1.2 bn PLN at June (dividend 828 m plus working capital). Q3 operating cash flow should therefore be positive, partly offset by Budimex's undisclosed share of the 135 m PLN Turów block-7 settlement the consortium paid to PGE GiEK (settled 17 June, paid by 22 Sep).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separately observable. The stock's big Q3 2025 move (+7.85%) came on a quarter that is seasonally cash-generative.
findings.original_quote: "W III i IV kwartale grupa spodziewa się konwersji sezonowo zwiększonego kapitału obrotowego na pieniądze." (In Q3 and Q4 the group expects the seasonally increased working capital to convert to cash.) Turów: "konsorcjum wypłaciło PGE GiEK 135 mln zł" (https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/W-wyniku-ugody-wykonawca-bloku-energetycznego-nr-7-w-Elektrowni-Turow-wyplacil-PGE-GiEK-135-mln-zl-9200850.html, 2026-09-22)
findings.why_not_priced: It lands inside what the company already said, so it is near zero. It is kept only because cash is the line a construction name can disappoint on, and the Turów outflow share is not public.
findings.independence: BDM sector note on positive 2026 OCF for builders (https://www.bankier.pl/wiadomosc/Spolki-budowlane-maja-szanse-na-dodatni-OCF-w-26-zagrozenia-dla-inwestycji-raczej-w-syt-budzetu-DM-BDM-9193623.html), headline only.

findings.finding: The sell side is uniformly below the price: over 12 months 3 sell, 2 underweight and 2 buy ratings, with an average target of 627 PLN and a maximum of 700 against spot ~728. Noble kept 'sprzedaj' and cut its target to 562 on 17 Sep. Any strategy without new numbers leaves analysts no reason to chase.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: BDM's downgrade on 8 May 2026 coincided with -2.68% the day after a -2.78% Q1 reaction.
findings.original_quote: "Noble Securities utrzymał rekomendację 'sprzedaj' dla Budimeksu, obniżył wycenę do 562 zł"
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: Budimex has traded above consensus targets for a long time. This is a weak reaction-asymmetry argument, not an informational edge, so it is kept near zero.

findings.finding: Q3 order intake and pipeline visible since June: Bechtel nuclear site works (208.9 m), DK10 bypass (154.4 m), Port Polska flood works (71 m), Katowice tram lowest bid (290.1 m, 23 Oct); Czajka bid rejected and DK73 award annulled. Backlog at 30 Sep is likely stable around 18 bn, consistent with the CEO's 'backlog up y/y' and '>8 bn signings' statements.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Backlog headlines alone have not visibly moved the stock: +2.05% on the D35 preferred-bidder day (7 Oct), flat on others.
findings.original_quote: "Oferta Budimeksu na budowę linii tramwajowej w Katowicach za ok. 290,1 mln zł najkorzystniejsza"; "Oferta Budimeksu na modernizację oczyszczalni ścieków 'Czajka' została odrzucona"
findings.why_not_priced: Each item was announced by ESPI and is priced individually. The aggregate backlog number is new in the release but sits inside management's stated expectation, so it is near zero.
findings.independence: CEO on 2026-09-11: 'Spodziewam się, że zwiększymy w tym roku portfel zamówień w stosunku do poprzedniego roku' (same Bankier interview as finding 1).

outside_window.finding: Czech D35 PPP: the consortium (Budimex 10%, Ferrovial's Cintra 30%, Strabag 40%, Invesis 20%) was chosen as best bidder on a 71.3 bn CZK (12.76 bn PLN) offer. The final award and any EPC share for Budimex are expected by year-end.

baseline_tension: The findings lean faintly negative, against a +5.29% 20-day run-up and the lean of -0.27 (the run-up itself). With no register, nothing here is orthogonal to the run-up except the strategy release, and its sign is unknown.
language_note: The issuer's own RB 4/2026 (Polish ESPI via parkiet) carried the report date and the fact that only FY2025 and H1 got Ferrovial-driven pre-releases, which establishes that Q3 numbers are NOT pre-released.
The prior QSr timestamps (18:18 for Q3 2025, 19:33 for Q1 2026) that settle the session as amc came only from the Polish ESPI mirrors.
The CEO's PAP Biznes interview, in Polish on Bankier, is the source for the strategy landing WITH the Q3 results. English sources found only an earlier 'strategy in 2026' / 'September' line.
GUS September construction output -9% y/y against +15.4% consensus, and the Pekao caveat on irregular settlements, came from Polish press.
The sell-side distribution (Bankier rekomendacje) and the Q3 contract flow (Katowice tram, Czajka rejection) are Polish-only.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (median 9.0% on a guidance change): the strategy published with the results is a guidance-type event, so abs_move_pct went from 6.5 to 7.5. Not the full 9, because the 2027 revenue target is already public and the stock's 20-day vol is 26%.
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series / macro-to-company is a hypothesis': the GUS sector finding went from -0.4 to -0.3.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not the thing to agree with': the sell-side-below-price finding went from -0.2 to -0.1.
'Your own session check ... open with the verdict': session_check now opens with 'amc' and cites the prior-cycle ESPI timestamps.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': I checked that the cash-flow line was already filed. Sign unchanged.
